lastCompletedStory.title: ADR: behavioral verification = shared runnable gate + independent reviewer verdict + artifact-of-record

nextStoryContext: US-007 created docs/adr/0005-behavioral-verification-shared-gate.md following the 0004 format (Status/Data, Contexto with three ADR gates, Decisao, Consequencias, Alternativas descartadas). The ADR records: behavioral verification is a shared runnable gate (src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts + test/integration tmux-real harness), invoked independently by implementer (Layer A, self-correct, non-official) and reviewer (Layer B, authoritative verdict). The reviewer's capture is written to scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt (gitignored) and posted as a PR comment at ship time. The ADR walks all three gates (hard-to-reverse, surprising-without-context, genuine-trade-off), records the rejected alternative (implementer-exclusive verification trusting implementer's green), and notes two deferred concerns: web image artifacts (playwright/agent-browser) and container/seccomp unix-socket question (CAM-152). All file-assert oracles pass. No em-dash, no decorative emoji.
